welcome: Connect to a session from the sidebar, or create a new terminal session.
keepRunning: Tasks keep running after you disconnect
batchDisconnectHelp: Disconnect all clients of the selected sessions; keep background tasks running
batchUnsupported: Some selected managers only support disconnecting sessions.
notInstalledHelp: Not installed · Set its path in settings
noManagersSelected:
No managers selected.
Choose them in MuxDock settings.
noManagersFound:
No selected managers found.
Install one and refresh, or set its path in settings.
clientExited: Connection to {name} exited ({code}). Check the terminal output and refresh to see the background session status.
sessionGone: Session no longer exists. Refresh the list.
windowGone: Window no longer exists. Refresh the list.
batchBusy: A batch action is already running.
confirmBatchKill: End {count} selected sessions? Their running programs will also end.
linkMissing: The linked file or directory does not exist.
windowsUnsupported: Use these managers in a Linux workspace through Remote WSL or Remote SSH.
shpoolAttached: This shpool session already has a client. Disconnect it in the original terminal first.
launchPrompt: Run in the selected shell for new sessions; return to the shell when the command exits.
noAvailableManagers: No selected managers are available. Select managers in MuxDock settings and install at least one, such as tmux or zmx.
tmuxDot: tmux replaces dots with underscores. Please use underscores.
nameTaken: Another terminal created this name. Select the existing session.
tmuxRenameDot: Use underscores instead of dots in tmux session names.
confirmKill: End session “{name}”? Its running programs will also end.
confirmCloseWindow: Close window “{name}”? Its running programs will also end.
nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens or dots. Start with a letter, number or underscore.
commandSingleLine: Enter a single line. Use && to join commands.
tmuxDetailsNote: tmux sessions share a server process. Each pane lists its own PID, working directory and running program.
executableMissing: {manager} is not installed or its executable path is invalid.
renameUnsupported: This manager does not support renaming sessions.
exitToEnd: Use exit inside the session to end the program.
shpoolNotReleased: shpool has not released the client. Try again shortly.
detachUnsupported: This manager cannot disconnect all clients.
zellijStillAttached: Zellij still has clients connected. Refresh and try again.
pythonRequired: Python 3 is required to read this manager's session processes. Install it and try again.
title: Title
zmxDetailsNote: The running command comes from the foreground process. Its working directory is used when available; otherwise the manager's last reported path is used.
detailsNote: Only data available from the manager and host is shown. Missing fields are unavailable in this manager or version.
windowUnsupported: This manager does not support window navigation.
xtermTooMuch: Too much output to announce. Navigate to a row to read it.
relativeCwdUnknown: Cannot determine the working directory for a relative session path.
socketMissing: Session socket not found. Refresh the list.
serverAmbiguous: Cannot uniquely identify the session socket's server process.
zellijAmbiguous: Cannot uniquely identify the Zellij session server.
serverUnverified: Cannot verify the session server. No clients were disconnected.
ptyPython: This environment requires Python 3 for terminal compatibility. Install it and try again.
managerPlatform: This manager is not supported on this host.
zellijWindowsVersion: Native Windows support requires Zellij 0.45.1 or later.
windowsCwdNote: Windows backends may report the initial directory after the shell changes directory. Treat these paths as last-reported values. Relative links use the connection directory unless the shell sends an updated directory.
zellijClientNotReady: The Zellij client is not ready. Wait for the terminal before changing tabs.
shellUnknownDrop: The current shell could not be identified. Retry the file drop at a PowerShell or CMD prompt.
cmdDropUnsupported: CMD expands % and ! in paths. This path cannot be inserted literally; use PowerShell.
herdrName: Use 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens; start with a letter, digit or underscore.
herdrNotReady: The Herdr session is not ready. Refresh and try again.
tmuxWindowsText: This tmux-windows release requires ASCII session/window names and startup paths. Use psmux or Herdr for Unicode paths.
settingsPrompt: Choose a setting, then select Next to edit it.
defaultDirectoryHelp: The starting directory for new sessions, for example ~/Projects. Existing sessions keep their own working directory.
visibleManagersHelp: Choose which session managers appear in the sidebar, such as tmux and zmx.
sshHostPrompt: Enter a Host alias from your SSH config or user@hostname. SSH port, key and jump-host settings are reused. Remote hosts support tmux and zmx.
sshHostInvalid: Enter a Host alias or user@hostname, without ssh options.
hostChanged: The host changed. Please try the action again.
removeSshHostPrompt: Remove {host} from this list? Open terminals and background sessions will be kept.
sshFailedTerminal: SSH exited with an error. Read the message above, then press Enter to close.
